Hanoi, Vietnam1 contribution

Authentic delicious food and democratic prices
Oct 2026 • Friends
In two days in Hanoi, this became our most vivid gastronomic experience - truly authentic Vietnamese cuisine. Found a place near our hotel according to the ratings. We tried a green mango salad, as well as an assortment of fresh herbs, noodles, and rolls wrapped in dark green leaves—all of which needed to be wrapped in thin rice paper and dipped in a piquant sauce; it was an amazing combination of flavors. We also really liked the fried fish served with fresh, thinly sliced greens, and the "pho" soup in fish broth with lemongrass and pineapple. The portions were huge: we could only eat part of the soup, 
 And the waiter kindly packed the rest for me. The service was prompt, and the waiter was very attentive: he even showed us how to eat the complex dishes correctly. Everything we tried was new to us - including "egg coffee," which turned out to be absolutely delicious. We left full and were completely delighted. We highly recommend this place! The prices here are reasonable, the food is authentic and delicious, and the portions are huge!

We are so happy that we chose this restaurant for our first dinner here in Hanoi! ❤️🇻🇳

Aside from the delicious food, what really made our experience special was how accommodating, friendly, and welcoming all the staff were. Everyone was so kind and attentive, and they really made us feel comfortable. Most of the staff also speak English very well, which made communicating so easy for us.

Special mention to Mrs. Rabbit! 🥰 Hewas incredibly kind and friendly. He even took the time to chat and share stories with us, which made our dinner even more enjoyable. What made it even more fun was that he knows a little bit of tagalog 🇵🇭❤️🇻🇳

The food was also delicious, flavorful, and satisfying. You can really feel the effort they put into making sure their guests have a great dining experience.

For our first dinner in Hanoi, we couldn’t have asked for a better place. The combination of good food, excellent service, friendly staff, and a warm atmosphere made our first night here extra memorable.

Thank you so much to the whole team, especially Mrs. Rabbit, for making us feel so welcome! 🥰 We will definitely recommend this place to other Filipinos visiting Hanoi, and we would love to come back again! 🇻🇳✨

Highly recommended! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Nice Food, Cosy Little Restaurant
Apr 2026 • Family
We came across Hong Hoai and had a pretty good experience overall. The location is convenient, and the restaurant itself is small but cosy, with a nice atmosphere.

The food was good and reasonably priced. The staff were also friendly and helpful during our visit.

The only thing that made us slightly uncomfortable was being encouraged quite a few times to leave a review. We prefer to write reviews based on our own experience, and I think reviews should be honest and natural. If we enjoy the food and the place, we are genuinely happy to give a good review without feeling pressured.

That aside, we enjoyed our meal and would recommend Hong Hoai if you're looking for good Vietnamese food at a reasonable price. Overall, a pleasant experience and worth trying.
